quantity: representative energy per logarithmic spectral interval

notes.xray: Approximate ROSAT diffuse X-ray energy intensity using representative photon energies of 0.25, 0.75, and 1.5 keV. Not a full PSPC spectral forward-fold.
notes.planck_30_353: CMB monopole plus differential K_CMB map median.
notes.infrared: Median across representative 12, 25, 60, and 100 micron SED values.
notes.visible: Median of Pioneer B and R lambda*I_lambda.
notes.ultraviolet: GALEX diffuse NUV background at 2316 Angstrom.
notes.gamma: Median E^2 dN/dE across the Fermi diffuse+isotropic energy grid.
